assetType: mobile profile multi-frame animated foreground layer
sharedPrompt: Portrait 2:3 production cutout source. Keep every animal and decoration inside the central 74% safe area with generous mobile-UI margins. Render on one perfectly uniform #FF00FF chroma-key backdrop without texture, shadow, haze or reflection. Never use magenta in the subject. No text, logo, border, watermark, crop, human or UI.
motionPrompt: Create a strict 4x2 contact sheet containing eight consistent sequential frames. Keep the subject center fixed and animate its real anatomy instead of translating, rotating or scaling the complete artwork. The first and last frame must join as a seamless loop. Use one uniform magenta chroma background with no labels or borders.
postProcessing: Crop eight equal cells, key the magenta backdrop to a real alpha channel, place each complete subject in a 640x960 mobile safe area, encode an 8 fps transparent animated WebP, and validate eight distinct frames plus transparent corners.
